body: Context: jsonc must keep Parse(x).Render()==x for every input and change only touched bytes. Chosen: the Doc owns its source bytes, the tree is spans over them, every edit is a splice followed by a re-parse; Render returns the bytes. Tolerant parse returns the partial tree plus a pos.ErrorList; edits on an invalid doc are refused (ErrInvalid). Alternatives: a token tree with trivia re-serialised on Render (rejected: two code paths to keep byte-exact, and config files are small enough that O(n) re-parse per edit costs nothing).
title: jsonc edits are byte splices plus re-parse
